concept.title: Machine Components Overview
concept.shortdesc: Structural breakdown and key functional assemblies of the GrainFlow X50 grain cleaning machine.

section.title: Primary Sub-Assemblies
section.p: The GrainFlow X50 consists of five primary mechanical and electrical sub-assemblies engineered for maximum reliability under continuous duty.

section.title: 1. Feed Hopper & Variable Speed Feed Roller
section.p: Accepts raw bulk grain up to 1200 L and ensures an even, single-kernel thick curtain across the entire width of the aspirator channel.

section.title: 2. Reciprocating Sieve Boat
section.p: Constructed from lightweight aircraft-grade aluminum. Holds interchangeable sieve frames equipped with rubber ball cleaners to prevent screen blinding during operation.

section.title: 3. Air Recirculation Separator & Blower Fan
section.p: Driven by a 45 kW motor, generating up to 14,000 m³/h airflow. Recirculates 85% of process air to minimize external dust emissions.

section.title: 4. Heavy-Duty Cyclone Collector
section.p: Separates fine chaff and airborne dust from exhaust air before discharging collected waste into waste bins or central dust extraction systems.

section.title: 5. Touchscreen Control Panel (Bühler YieldMaster UI)
section.p: Provides centralized control over feed rate, air damper position, sieve frequency, and real-time sensor diagnostic readouts.
